State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue Increased Position in Tiffany & Co New (TIF) by $842,540 as Valuation Declined; California Public Employees Retirement System Has Lowered Its Unit (UNT) Stake by $385,182
May 20, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue increased its stake in Tiffany & Co New (TIF) by 39.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue bought 8,180 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 28,743 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.99M, up from 20,563 at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue who had been investing in Tiffany & Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.80% or $0.83 $103.35. About 1.02M shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500.
California Public Employees Retirement System decreased its stake in Unit Corp (UNT) by 8.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. California Public Employees Retirement System sold 18,342 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.47% with the market. The institutional investor held 208,052 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.58M, down from 226,394 at the end of the previous reported quarter. California Public Employees Retirement System who had been investing in Unit Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.68% or $0.39 $22.78. About 299,129 shares traded. Unit Corporation (NYSE:UNT) has declined 23.47% downtrending. It has underperformed by 35.02% the S&P500.
